title: 公共业务门面与 MCP CLI 集成
status_note: Audit 6.1-audit closed: no P0; all eight P1 and all fifteen P2 findings fixed or explicitly downgraded with a recorded reason.
record_commit: the commit containing this record file
worktree_note: Recorded relative to the user home because the contract privacy validator rejects absolute home-directory paths; the absolute path stays in the execution session.

contract_revision.change: /resources documents the semester parameter (the 4.2 index is per semester and cannot resolve a default); additive, recorded in x-revisions.

outputs: the frozen six-method business facade: query, health, prepare, execute, result and cancel
a capability registration built from each module's own report; a module file existing is never evidence of availability
registration states AVAILABLE/DISABLED/BLOCKED/MISSING with reason, owner, adapter version, authorization class, side effects, evidence level, prepare_allowed and executable
one registration list for describe_service state, the prepare/execute gates and the health report; an unregistered read is refused instead of falling back to QueryEngine
campus.page is registered so the only executable page read has a public capability block
agenda, agenda_changes and resources registered as local reads inside the existing query_service entry; the 29 legacy MCP tools and their arguments stay unchanged
agenda pages a materialised window with a process-local snapshot cursor; agenda_changes keeps the incremental change_cursor separate from the paging next_cursor
resources uses the 4.2 provider's own max_search_limit, reports a capped read as not complete with RESOURCE_SEARCH_LIMIT_APPLIED, and emits a frozen-envelope verification level
read entries refuse write operation names and method/headers/token/cookie proxy fields, including nested ones; url is accepted only for the registered campus.page read
blocked campus writes are refused before any preflight, adapter call or browser page is touched; switched-off writes raise their registered switch code
legacy framework operations without an adapter keep their ADAPTER_REQUIRED plan shape and error code
health aggregates PARTIAL/BLOCKED/DISABLED/MISSING and reports every catalog service plus facade-only services
request ids are typed (1 and "1" differ) and bound to queue state, transport cancellation, media cleanup and the result envelope
queued cancel takes effect immediately, running cancel stays CANCELLED after the handler returns, failures are FAILED, and cleanup runs exactly once
CLI subcommands describe/health/query/agenda/dashboard beside the unchanged legacy commands and flags; README documents the migration
openthu dashboard fixes host/port/facade as its provider contract and fails closed with LOCAL_DASHBOARD_UNAVAILABLE until 6.2 supplies local_api
every MCP error keeps a provider's registered code and carries the classified fields; the request-limit error is classified too
13 new error codes registered in contracts/v0.2/error-classification.json and mirrored in source_state.ERROR_CODES

capability_registry.available_reads: every registered read operation of info, learn, library, sports, campus plus local.agenda/agenda_changes

blocked.library.renew_loan: SOURCE_CONTRACT_UNVERIFIED (prepare allowed, execute refused); DISABLED when THU_LIBRARY_RENEW=0
blocked.learn.submit_assignment: BLOCKED_SOURCE_EVIDENCE (write switch THU_LEARN_SUBMIT off by default)

missing.local.resources: RESOURCE_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE until a 4.2 provider is injected
missing.local.resources_export: NO_PUBLIC_ENTRY (4.2 export_summary is a host API)
missing.local.media_prepare: NO_PUBLIC_ENTRY (3.3 registration is a host API)

local agenda, agenda_changes and resources results validate against result-envelope-v1
campus.page is registered and executable; an unregistered read returns UNREGISTERED_QUERY_OPERATION without reaching QueryEngine
url is accepted only for the registered campus.page read and rejected for every other query or prepare payload
health returns OK for info, PARTIAL for library/sports/learn/local and BLOCKED for academics
every service listed by describe() can be described, including facade-only academics
resources no longer accepts offset/limit and requires semester
media_prepare and resources_export are MISSING with NO_PUBLIC_ENTRY and no facade method pretends otherwise
a non-CampusError provider code survives the MCP and CLI boundaries as RESOURCE_INVALID_ARGUMENT/INPUT
THU_TODOS=0 marks agenda DISABLED; THU_LIBRARY_RENEW=0 marks renewal DISABLED and prepare raises LIBRARY_RENEW_DISABLED
an injected env and clock drive registration state and request timestamps
export_agenda rejects non-boolean overwrite/allow_partial and an unsupported format before delegating
query results report probe=SOURCE_READ instead of reusing the static live_probe flag
the request-limit error carries category/retryable/automatic_replay_allowed/user_action
a failed request ends FAILED, a cancelled running request ends CANCELLED, and a queued cancel never calls the handler
JSON-RPC ids 1 and "1" are distinct request keys
cancelling an unknown request does not touch media staging
an academics report failure leaves three MISSING entries and a sanitised registration_failures record
service_ids follows a catalog refresh without a restart
the local read contract documents semester for /resources
README documents the new CLI commands, the command field and the classified error shape
renewal may prepare an official handoff but execute is refused with SOURCE_CONTRACT_UNVERIFIED and zero adapter calls
a blocked submission prepare is refused with its blocked scope and write switch, and the engine is never called
local registers exactly agenda, agenda_changes and resources; no generic page/status fallback
agenda pages a three-event window 2+1 with views over the whole window and a cursor bound to the parameters
agenda_changes keeps change_cursor (evc1) distinct from the paging next_cursor (c1) and forwards the previous change cursor
a capped resource search is not complete and carries RESOURCE_SEARCH_LIMIT_APPLIED
query refuses write operation names and top-level or nested method/headers/token/cookie fields
prepare rejects read and unknown operations without touching the engine
execute refuses an unknown plan and never creates one
execute routes a learn plan to the submission engine and a sports plan to the shared action engine
result reads the owning engine and never dispatches
prepare -> execute without host confirmation is refused (0 dispatches); after confirmation exactly one dispatch happens and a repeat only reads back
legacy framework create keeps its ADAPTER_REQUIRED plan shape and error code
queued cancel runs cleanup once and reports started_before_cancel=false
running cancel reports CANCELLATION_REQUESTED and ends CANCELLED after finish
an unknown or finished request cancel is not a success and never replays
the request registry refuses work beyond its active limit
cancel binds media cleanup for live requests and reports remote_effect NONE
a query result carries the bound request id
export_agenda passes an explicit absolute target to the local writer and is typed LOCAL_WRITE
health is static, covers every known service and survives one failing service without leaking its text
a registered learn read keeps its legacy envelope fields and reports service_domain LEARN
the MCP error result carries category/retryable/automatic_replay_allowed/user_action and the capability block without paths or account data
the CLI keeps the six legacy commands and flags and adds describe/health/query/agenda/dashboard
CLI malformed, non-object and missing parameters are structured errors with an empty stderr
openthu dashboard refuses a public bind and reports LOCAL_DASHBOARD_UNAVAILABLE
the MCP stdio process answers initialize/tools/list/describe_service/query_service and an unknown cancel notification as clean JSON lines
every facade error code is registered in the contract and mirrored in source_state with the same category
limits: thu_assistant.local_api (6.2) is absent, so openthu dashboard returns LOCAL_DASHBOARD_UNAVAILABLE; host/port/facade are already fixed as its provider contract.
local.resources needs an injected 4.2 ResourceCenter; with a provider it works and is capped by that provider's max_search_limit (50 by default), reporting the cap as incomplete rather than failing.
local.resources_export and local.media_prepare are MISSING/NO_PUBLIC_ENTRY: the 4.2 export and 3.3 registration APIs exist only for the host, and 6.1 does not advertise a CLI/MCP entry for them.
The 3.3/4.5 media pipeline needs an injected MediaAssets and MediaBinding; without them image calls keep MODEL_IMAGE_INPUT_UNAVAILABLE and the shipped protocol registry stays empty.
Renewal can prepare an official handoff and read a result only; execute is refused before preflight with SOURCE_CONTRACT_UNVERIFIED, and THU_LIBRARY_RENEW=0 marks it DISABLED.
Assignment submission, personal timetable, exams and grades remain blocked on source evidence; this module only records the gap and never fabricates an empty success.
health is a static capability registration, not proof of login, source readability or business availability; every query still reads its source.
agenda, agenda_changes and resources use process-local snapshots with a 600-second TTL; change_cursor and next_cursor have different meanings and cannot be exchanged.
The local read contract revision documents semester for /resources; 6.2 must supply the user-selected or configured current semester.
gateway.js was not changed: no new gateway command was needed, and the existing queue/cancel/progress wiring is reused.
Batch 6 is not complete: 6.2 and 6.3 are still pending, so this module acceptance does not make the batch accepted.

The public tool list stays at 29 and there is no data migration. Writes can be suspended without a code rollback through THU_LIBRARY_WRITE=0, THU_SPORTS_WRITE=0, THU_LIBRARY_RENEW=0 and THU_LEARN_SUBMIT=0.

P1.fix: resources reads through the provider's own max_search_limit instead of a fixed limit=200; a test with the real file-keyed ResourceCenter proves the default ceiling works

query refuses an unregistered operation (UNREGISTERED_QUERY_OPERATION) instead of falling back to QueryEngine; campus is a registered service and campus.page has a full public capability block; describe_service never emits a bare {'state':'UNKNOWN'}
health aggregates PARTIAL when some rows are available and some blocked, plus BLOCKED/DISABLED/MISSING/UNKNOWN instead of collapsing every non-all-available service to UNKNOWN
describe_service builds a registry-only description for facade-only services and maps catalog misses to FACADE_SERVICE_UNKNOWN; academics is describable
offset/limit removed from the local.resources schema; paging uses cursor/page_size and the provider ceiling, so no accepted parameter is silently ignored

media_prepare and resources_export are MISSING with reason NO_PUBLIC_ENTRY and entry=none; the undocumented facade.export_resources method was removed, so the capability table no longer claims an entry it lacks
MCP and CLI take any string .code, not only CampusError subclasses, so 4.2/4.1 provider codes keep their registered category
local reads emit LOCAL_EXECUTION_STATE, and a missing provider checked_at falls back to the query time so the envelope stays valid
